# Ezekiel 15 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 15:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | And the word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | Then the LORD spoke to me: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 15:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Is wood taken from-it to-make into-any work? Or-do-they-take from-it a-peg to-hang upon-it any vessel? |
| LOGOS | Is wood taken from it to use for anything? Do people take a peg from it to hang any vessel on it? |
| PNEUMA | Can you make anything useful from it? Can you even make a peg to hang something on? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 15:4 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Behold, to-the-fire it-is-given for-fuel; its-two ends the-fire has-consumed, and-its-middle is-charred — is-it-useful for-any work? |
| LOGOS | Behold, it is given to the fire for fuel. When the fire has consumed both ends of it, and the middle of it is charred, is it useful for anything? |
| PNEUMA | It's only good for fuel. And if both ends are already burned and the middle is charred — what use is it then? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 15:8 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-make the-land a-desolation because they-acted unfaithfully,'" declares the-Lord YHWH. |
| LOGOS | And I will make the land desolate, because they have acted faithlessly, declares the Lord GOD." |
| PNEUMA | I will turn the land into a wasteland because they have been unfaithful, declares the Lord GOD." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 15:7 (overlap: 13%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-set My-face against-them; from-the-fire they-went-out, and-the-fire shall-consume-them; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH when-I-set My-face against-them. |
| LOGOS | And I will set My face against them. Though they escape from the fire, the fire shall yet consume them, and you will know that I am the LORD, when I set My face against them. |
| PNEUMA | I have set My face against them. They've escaped one fire, but another fire will consume them. When I turn against them, you will know that I am the LORD. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 15:5 (overlap: 14%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Behold, when-it-was whole it-was-not-made into-any work; how-much-less when the-fire has-consumed-it and-it-is-charred — can-it-still-be-made into-any work? |
| LOGOS | Behold, when it was whole, it was used for nothing. How much less, when the fire has consumed it and it is charred, can it ever be used for anything! |
| PNEUMA | When it was whole it was useless. Now that it's burned, it's even more useless! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
